subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum has a scholar's interest in Stroud that he performs slightly harder than the interest actually requires.
source_quote: he has a scholar's interest in Stroud that he performs slightly harder than the interest actually requires

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembers a love involving giants from the previous campaign.
source_quote: The only love I remember during the previous campaign, involved giants, and it wasn't Stroud's

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes things must be received with a grain of salt.
source_quote: These things have to be done with a grain of salt

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices faces, patterns, and small deviations from baseline behavior when sitting somewhere new.
source_quote: I had been cataloguing the room during all of this, which is not something I do consciously anymore. It is just what happens when I sit somewhere new: faces, patterns, the small deviations from baseline behavior

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices the young human scholar's chant is rhythmically almost correct but wrong by a hair.
source_quote: His breathing was almost right. The pauses fell almost correctly. The pattern was almost the one it was supposed to be — and wrong by a hair in a way that took actual knowledge of the correct version to notice

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recognizes the chant's specific degradation pattern from Eldred and the Field Ward Preacher.
source_quote: I have seen it before. Twice. Eldred had it, earlier in the journey — the man who went insane. The Field Ward Preacher had it too.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows the chant well enough to identify its precise wrongness.
source_quote: I know that chant. I know it well enough to know what he was doing wrong, and the specific wrongness of it

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes Candlekeep would have records to identify the chant's origin.
source_quote: Candlekeep would have records. Someone there would know whether this pattern belonged to a group, a practice, a doctrine — or whether it was something else being made to look like one

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin found his first real encounter with the sea peaceful despite Dawnbringer's light defeating the purpose.
source_quote: Thorin apparently found this peaceful rather than counterproductive

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin had a thought that satisfied him during his time by the sea.
source_quote: He came back in with the settled look of a man who had had a thought that satisfied him

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says life takes you in weird directions and weird places, and you just gotta go with it.
source_quote: Life takes you in weird directions and weird places, you just gotta go with it

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is uncertain whether Thorin’s statement is wisdom or resignation.
source_quote: I have not yet decided whether it is wisdom or resignation

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir closed an internal argument when he returned from meditating on the roof.
source_quote: He came back down later, settled. The expression of someone closing an internal argument, not opening an external one

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said 'Hmm, true' in the tone of someone completing an internal argument.
source_quote: He said 'Hmm, true,' about something, in the tone of a man completing an internal argument rather than beginning an external one

subject: Daz
fact: Daz understands the wall remembers better than he would like to.
source_quote: I find I understand that better than I would like to

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed Daz's unusual quiet and hand to his temple during the walk to Candlekeep.
source_quote: Daz went quiet beside me somewhere around the second hour of walking. Not his usual quiet. His hand went to his temple and stayed there. I noticed.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir files the connection between Daz’s condition and the spreading madness from the Underdark.
source_quote: Whatever was happening to Daz had started below ground and apparently had not stopped at the surface. One more thing that needed answering.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers a class on the difference between solutions and postponements, and thinks about it at moments like this one.
source_quote: I remember nothing else from that class. I remember wanting to be in the training hall. I have thought about it perhaps four times since, at moments exactly like this one.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes Glabbagool’s interaction with the spy is a form of pre-monk training.
source_quote: Absolutely," I said. It was. Patience under provocation. Maintaining stillness when the environment is actively hostile. Responding to aggression without being ruled by it. If anything, the spy was giving him a better curriculum than most of what I'd sat through.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool wonders whether watching the spy makes him more or less of a monk.
source_quote: Zalthir? Will I be more of a monk or less of a monk by watching her? Is this some kind of pre-monk training you've put me in?

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool takes Zalthir’s affirmation seriously and commits to watching the spy.
source_quote: Glabbagool took this with complete seriousness. The work counted; he had been told so.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recognizes that Khell-Vire’s question is about what he has become, not what he knows.
source_quote: Khell-Vire wasn't asking what Zalthir knew. He was asking what Zalthir had become through what he'd lived. That's a different inquiry.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir finds Khell-Vire’s questioning annoying, as it reminds him of ignored shadow monk classes.
source_quote: Zalthir, to his credit, didn't pretend to find it profound. He found it annoying, in the specific way that all those shadow monk classes he'd ignored had been annoying

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realizes the blind monk’s challenge is testing what he hasn’t learned, not what he has.
source_quote: Show me what else you haven't learned.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knows he has never practiced the formal shadow monk forms while traveling.
source_quote: He had not practiced his forms while traveling. He had survived the Underdark, which is a different curriculum.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir considers whether he could attack the monk while walking away.
source_quote: Zalthir: 'I mean, I rolled a 30 to hit. Does that get me anything?'
